review_candidates.title: Business Operations Manager (Engineering Background)
review_candidates.description: The Business Operations Manager is responsible for driving the execution of the company's commercial strategy by ensuring effective coordination between Executive Management, Sales Teams, Product Management, and other supporting functions. The role serves as the central operational link across departments, translating strategic objectives into actionable plans, monitoring execution, resolving cross-functional challenges, and ensuring alignment with the organization's business goals. Leveraging a strong engineering background and commercial mindset, the Business Operations Manager oversees operational performance, enhances business processes, supports decision-making through data-driven insights, and ensures that commercial initiatives are executed efficiently while maintaining high standards of collaboration, accountability, and customer satisfaction. RESPONSIBILITIES Translate executive management decisions into clear operational plans and ensure their successful implementation across all commercial functions. Drive the execution of strategic initiatives while monitoring progress against business objectives. Ensure organizational priorities are effectively communicated and executed. Act as the primary liaison between Executive Management and Sales, Product Management, Technical Support, Supply Chain, and other business functions. Foster collaboration between departments to ensure seamless business operations. Resolve operational issues and remove barriers affecting business performance. Monitor the overall performance of Sales and Product Management teams through defined KPIs. Ensure business activities are aligned with company objectives and operational standards. Support sales planning, forecasting, and commercial performance improvement initiatives. Monitor sales pipeline health and execution effectiveness. Develop and maintain operational dashboards and executive reports. Analyze business performance, identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement. Present regular business performance updates and recommendations to senior management. Review and improve operational workflows, business processes, and internal coordination mechanisms. Establish and maintain standardized operating procedures to improve efficiency and consistency. Lead continuous improvement initiatives across commercial operations. Coordinate cross-functional projects and ensure timely execution. Monitor project milestones, resource allocation, and deliverables. Ensure accountability for action plans across departments. Provide operational guidance and support to Sales and Product Management teams. Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Coach team leaders on execution excellence and operational discipline. Identify operational risks and implement corrective actions. Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and governance standards. REQUIREMENTS Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Civil, Electrical, Architecture, Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering discipline). MBA or postgraduate studies in Business Administration is a plus. Minimum 12 –15 years of professional experience. At least 5 years in a leadership role within Business Operations, Commercial Operations, Sales Management, or Technical Commercial Management. Experience in Fit-Out, Building Materials, Construction Solutions, Interior Finishing, or Architectural Products is highly preferred. Proven experience managing cross-functional teams and driving business execution. Strong commercial and business acumen. Experience with ERP systems (Odoo is preferred). Strong knowledge of CRM systems and sales operations. Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills. Experience with Power BI or other business intelligence tools is an advantage. Strong understanding of KPI management and performance reporting. Strategic Thinking Leadership & People Management Cross-Functional Coordination Business Process Improvement Commercial Awareness Analytical & Data-Driven Decision Making Project Management Problem Solving Communication & Presentation Skills Negotiation & Influencing Skills Time Management & Prioritization Results-Oriented Mindset Change Management Stakeholder Management High level of professionalism, integrity, and accountability

review_candidates.title: Business Development Specialist
review_candidates.description: Company Description Ensdim is a technology and digital solutions partner that helps businesses enhance customer experience, streamline operations, connect data, and make better decisions. The team begins by deeply understanding customer journeys, team workflows, operational challenges, and data signals, then designs and builds digital solutions tailored to actual business needs. Ensdim delivers a wide range of solutions including digital platforms and websites, mobile applications, internal systems, customer portals, dashboards, workflow automation, and AI-enabled tools. The company supports organizations across the Gulf and wider MENA region, focusing on reducing manual work, improving operational visibility, and creating scalable, customer-centered operations. Guided by the principle “Listen to data. Understand business. Build solutions,” Ensdim offers a collaborative environment for professionals passionate about digital transformation. Role Description The Business Development Specialist contract role is a remote position focused on identifying, qualifying, and nurturing new business opportunities for Ensdim’s technology and digital solutions. Day-to-day responsibilities include researching target markets, building prospect lists, and initiating contact through calls, emails, and online meetings to understand client needs. The specialist will prepare and present proposals, collaborate with technical and delivery teams to shape solution offerings, and support negotiations that align client expectations with Ensdim’s capabilities. This role also involves maintaining a structured sales pipeline, updating CRM records, tracking performance metrics, and contributing to go-to-market initiatives and campaigns. The specialist will work closely with leadership to refine messaging, gather market feedback, and help build long-term relationships across the Gulf and MENA region. Qualifications Business development, sales prospecting, and lead generation skills, with the ability to manage a structured pipeline and meet growth targets. Client relationship management and communication skills, including conducting discovery calls, understanding business needs, and presenting solutions clearly. Market research and analytical skills to assess industries, identify opportunities, and translate data and insights into actionable strategies. Experience or familiarity with technology, digital platforms, mobile applications, workflow automation, and AI-enabled solutions in a B2B context. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; additional regional languages (e.g., Arabic) are an advantage. Ability to work independently in a remote setting, manage time effectively, and collaborate virtually with cross-functional teams. Prior experience in the Gulf or wider MENA region, or working with clients in these markets, is highly beneficial. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in business development or sales.

behavior Diagnose test failures, investigate bugs, and drive issues through root-cause analysis and resolution Measure the performance impact of code changes and prevent or resolve regressions junior engineers and interns What you bring Required At least five years of experience programming, debugging, and performance-tuning distributed or highly concurrent software systems Strong systems technical communication skills A collaborative approach and the ability to make realistic assessments of project complexity and delivery risk Preferred Professional experience developing production
